neighbours.label: the corridors, hallways and walls of a building, as opposed to roads and yards outside, and to other parts of the building or room in the same frames
fire: She walked along the narrow corridor to her office.
A long hallway runs through the middle of the school.
Family photos covered the walls of the living room.
The nurse hurried down the corridor toward the ward.
He leaned against the wall of the hallway and waited.
Damp had stained the walls of the upstairs bedroom.
The rooms open onto a wide corridor on each floor.
They hung a large map on the wall in the classroom.
quiet: She walked along the narrow lane to her office.
A long staircase runs through the middle of the school.
Family photos covered the shelves of the living room.
The nurse hurried down the road toward the bus.
He leaned against the gate of the yard and waited.
Damp had stained the carpet of the upstairs bedroom.
The stalls open onto a wide square on each side.
They put a large map on the table in the classroom.
